title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
excerpt: From feet to fingertips — we are teaching robots intelligent whole-body control, fine dexterity, and teamwork to complete a broad range of complex tasks.
content_html:
July 30, 2026 Models

Carolina Parada

From feet to fingertips — we are teaching robots intelligent whole-body control, fine dexterity, and teamwork to complete a broad range of complex tasks

For decades, we’ve dreamed of robots that can seamlessly step into our world and lend a hand. Now, that vision takes a significant stride forward.

Most robots are pre-programmed or teleoperated for narrow, repetitive task sequences. They lack the ability to truly learn for themselves or adapt to unpredictable environments. Moreover, transferring learned skills from one robot body to another remains incredibly difficult. To take on the hardest problems at scale, robots of every shape and size need AI models giving them the ability to think, act, and interact intelligently to safely complete tasks.

We demonstrated how Gemini's multimodal understanding could drive real-world action with Gemini Robotics. Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2 - the intelligence layer powering the next generation of truly adaptable robots. As it takes its first literal steps, this major advance unlocks intelligent whole-body control, advanced dexterity, and multi-robot collaboration.

Gemini Robotics 2 enables robots to reason through every movement, unlocking a broad range of tasks. For example, it can enable a humanoid to walk, crouch, stretch, and manipulate objects to clean up a cluttered room. It can even team up with other robots to finish the job faster. And this profound intelligence can also run locally on-device while seamlessly adapting to entirely new robotic bodies in just a few hours.

We are making this possible through three highly capable models:

  • Gemini Robotics 2: Our most advanced vision-language-action model (VLA) that converts vision and language input into motor control, enabling a robot to take action. This model is capable of controlling full humanoids, from feet to fingertips, and other bi-arm robots. It also brings a new level of dexterous manipulation on both hands and grippers.
  • Gemini Robotics ER 2: Our most capable embodied reasoning (ER) model. It is a vision language model (VLM) that acts as our agent, enabling robots to communicate with humans, understand the physical world and plan multi-step tasks lasting several minutes. We are also introducing the ability for robots to work together as a team.
  • Gemini Robotics On-Device 2: Our most efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices. This model can now achieve fast adaptation to completely new robot embodiments with a few hours of data.

Gemini Robotics ER 2, our reasoning model, is now available on Google AI Studio and in private preview on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Our VLA and On-Device models are available to early-access partners. Read how to bring these models to your hardware on our Developer blog.

Humanoids in motion: Managing whole-body tasks

The world is built for human movements; it requires us to reach, bend, and balance in tight, cluttered spaces. While our previous models controlled the humanoid’s upper-body to achieve table-top tasks, Gemini Robotics 2 expands physical AI into whole-body motions.

For the first time, our model can now control entire humanoid robots, translating intent into intelligent whole-body control. For example, when controlling Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid robot, we can ask it to “put the watering can into the green bin in the bottom shelf.” Apollo processes the instruction, walks to the table, and picks up the watering can, takes a few steps to the shelves, and places it precisely in its destination. While our robots have more to advance in movement speed, this is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.

Bringing advanced dexterity to hands and grippers

To be genuinely useful in our homes and workplaces, robots need finesse. Gemini Robotics 2 unlocks a new level of physical dexterity across different end effectors, whether a robot is using hands or grippers, enabling robots to be more useful than ever before.

The model can now control the five-fingered, 22 degree-of-freedom SharpaWave hand on the Apollo 2 robot to complete delicate actions like tying knots or sealing a ziplock bag. It can also operate standard two-fingered parallel grippers on a Franka Duo platform to perform complex dexterous tasks (e.g. tight packing). We are continuing to advance the level of precision and speed to achieve human-level dexterity.

Unlocking advanced tasks with agentic reasoning and multi-robot collaboration

Most real-world tasks require multiple steps over an extended period of time. To manage this complexity, our embodied reasoning (ER) model, Gemini Robotics ER 2, serves as the robot’s high-level brain, processing user instructions and communicating with humans. It observes the room, reasons about the steps needed to complete the task, coordinates with the VLA to carry out the actions, and tracks progress until the task is done. This setup allows robots to execute complex multi-step tasks, self-correct if a step fails, and generalize to novel situations and goals.

In this update, we are enabling robots to more reliably execute longer task sequences, lasting several minutes and involving hundreds of decisions. Gemini Robotics ER 2 now understands when tasks begin and end, and can pinpoint the moment key events occur, marking a step change in progress understanding.

Furthermore, we are introducing multi-robot collaboration. This enables different types of robots to communicate and work together to solve complex workflows a single robot could not do alone.

Adapting fast on-device models for any robot

Many robotic applications need to operate without network latency or internet connectivity. Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 is built specifically to handle these constraints — it is our most-efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices.

This model is natively multi-embodiment and inherits our advanced “motion transfer” techniques from Gemini Robotics 1.5. We can now adapt to new bi-arm robot embodiments with just a few hours of adaptation time, typically with less than 200 examples. This works even with new embodiments with drastically different shapes, sensors and degrees of freedom, as shown below with a diverse set of tasks being performed by the Dexmate, SO101, and Trossen platforms.

Advancing our commitment to safe and responsible robotics

Safety is foundational to our robotics research. As robots gain more physical capabilities, we are committed to ensuring end-to-end safety and alignment. With each release, we’ve taken a multi-layered approach that combines traditional physical safety measures with robust AI safety frameworks.

Gemini Robotics 2 specifically advances robotics safety for navigating the uncertainty of the real world and collaborating alongside humans.

We’re introducing ASIMOV-Agentic, a new benchmark for agentic safety orchestration and uncertainty resolution. For example, it measures the embodied reasoning agent’s ability to refuse unsafe tool calls from a VLA.It also measures the agent’s ability to predict whether a task is possible and to proactively request human intervention when uncertain.

Additionally, with enhanced embodied reasoning, Gemini Robotics ER 2 is our safest robotics model to date in safety constraint following and human proximity benchmarks. It can better detect when humans are nearby, trigger safety tool calls and bring the robot to a safe stop if someone approaches too closely. This is a key requirement in collaborative safety standards. Read our Gemini Robotics 2: Safety Technical Report for more details.

Building towards general-purpose physical AI

Gemini Robotics 2 marks an important milestone on the path toward solving AGI in the physical world. Unlocking the true potential of robotics requires moving past single-task automation toward general-purpose intelligence. By building this core intelligence, our goal is to enable AI in the physical world that can work alongside humans to solve complex challenges.

sentences.en: It also brings a new level of dexterous manipulation on both hands and grippers.
sentences.zh: 它还将双手和抓手的灵巧操控提升到了新的水平。

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics ER 2: Our most capable embodied reasoning (ER) model.
sentences.zh: Gemini Robotics ER 2：我们最强大的具身推理 (ER) 模型。

sentences.en: It is a vision language model (VLM) that acts as our agent, enabling robots to communicate with humans, understand the physical world and plan multi-step tasks lasting several minutes.

sentences.en: We are also introducing the ability for robots to work together as a team.
sentences.zh: 我们还介绍了机器人作为一个团队一起工作的能力。

blocks.html_en: • Gemini Robotics On-Device 2: Our most efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices. This model can now achieve fast adaptation to completely new robot embodiments with a few hours of data.

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2: Our most efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices.

sentences.en: This model can now achieve fast adaptation to completely new robot embodiments with a few hours of data.

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics ER 2, our reasoning model, is now available on Google AI Studio and in private preview on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.

blocks.html_en: Humanoids in motion: Managing whole-body tasks

sentences.en: Humanoids in motion: Managing whole-body tasks
sentences.zh: 运动中的人形机器人：管理全身任务

blocks.html_en: The world is built for human movements; it requires us to reach, bend, and balance in tight, cluttered spaces. While our previous models controlled the humanoid’s upper-body to achieve table-top tasks, Gemini Robotics 2 expands physical AI into whole-body motions.

sentences.en: The world is built for human movements; it requires us to reach, bend, and balance in tight, cluttered spaces.
sentences.zh: 世界是为人类运动而建立的；它要求我们在狭窄、杂乱的空间中伸展、弯曲和保持平衡。

sentences.en: While our previous models controlled the humanoid’s upper-body to achieve table-top tasks, Gemini Robotics 2 expands physical AI into whole-body motions.
sentences.zh: 我们之前的模型控制人形机器人的上半身来完成桌面任务，而 Gemini Robotics 2 将物理 AI 扩展到全身运动。

blocks.html_en: For the first time, our model can now control entire humanoid robots, translating intent into intelligent whole-body control. For example, when controlling Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid robot, we can ask it to “put the watering can into the green bin in the bottom shelf.” Apollo processes the instruction, walks to the table, and picks up the watering can, takes a few steps to the shelves, and places it precisely in its destination. While our robots have more to advance in movement speed, this is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.

sentences.en: For the first time, our model can now control entire humanoid robots, translating intent into intelligent whole-body control.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型现在第一次可以控制整个人形机器人，将意图转化为智能全身控制。

sentences.en: For example, when controlling Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid robot, we can ask it to “put the watering can into the green bin in the bottom shelf.”
sentences.zh: 例如，在控制Apptronik的Apollo 2人形机器人时，我们可以要求它“将喷壶放入最底层架子的绿色垃圾桶中”。

sentences.en: Apollo processes the instruction, walks to the table, and picks up the watering can, takes a few steps to the shelves, and places it precisely in its destination.
sentences.zh: 阿波罗处理完指令，走到桌子旁，拿起喷壶，走到架子上，然后将其精确地放置在目的地。

sentences.en: While our robots have more to advance in movement speed, this is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们的机器人在移动速度方面还有更多进步，但这是朝着完成需要全身协调的更复杂、现实世界任务所需的技能迈出的重要一步。

blocks.html_en: Bringing advanced dexterity to hands and grippers

sentences.en: Bringing advanced dexterity to hands and grippers
sentences.zh: 为手和夹具带来先进的灵活性

blocks.html_en: To be genuinely useful in our homes and workplaces, robots need finesse. Gemini Robotics 2 unlocks a new level of physical dexterity across different end effectors, whether a robot is using hands or grippers, enabling robots to be more useful than ever before.

sentences.en: To be genuinely useful in our homes and workplaces, robots need finesse.
sentences.zh: 为了在我们的家庭和工作场所真正发挥作用，机器人需要技巧。

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics 2 unlocks a new level of physical dexterity across different end effectors, whether a robot is using hands or grippers, enabling robots to be more useful than ever before.
sentences.zh: Gemini Robotics 2 将不同末端执行器的物理灵活性提升到了一个新的水平，无论机器人是使用手还是夹具，使机器人比以往任何时候都更有用。

blocks.html_en: The model can now control the five-fingered, 22 degree-of-freedom SharpaWave hand on the Apollo 2 robot to complete delicate actions like tying knots or sealing a ziplock bag. It can also operate standard two-fingered parallel grippers on a Franka Duo platform to perform complex dexterous tasks (e.g. tight packing). We are continuing to advance the level of precision and speed to achieve human-level dexterity.

sentences.en: The model can now control the five-fingered, 22 degree-of-freedom SharpaWave hand on the Apollo 2 robot to complete delicate actions like tying knots or sealing a ziplock bag.
sentences.zh: 该模型现在可以控制 Apollo 2 机器人上的五指、22 自由度 SharpaWave 手来完成打结或密封自封袋等精细动作。

sentences.en: It can also operate standard two-fingered parallel grippers on a Franka Duo platform to perform complex dexterous tasks (e.g. tight packing).
sentences.zh: 它还可以在 Franka Duo 平台上操作标准的两指平行夹具，以执行复杂的灵巧任务（例如紧密包装）。

sentences.en: We are continuing to advance the level of precision and speed to achieve human-level dexterity.
sentences.zh: 我们正在不断提高精度和速度水平，以实现人类水平的灵活性。

blocks.html_en: Unlocking advanced tasks with agentic reasoning and multi-robot collaboration

sentences.en: Unlocking advanced tasks with agentic reasoning and multi-robot collaboration
sentences.zh: 通过代理推理和多机器人协作解锁高级任务

blocks.html_en: Most real-world tasks require multiple steps over an extended period of time. To manage this complexity, our embodied reasoning (ER) model, Gemini Robotics ER 2, serves as the robot’s high-level brain, processing user instructions and communicating with humans. It observes the room, reasons about the steps needed to complete the task, coordinates with the VLA to carry out the actions, and tracks progress until the task is done. This setup allows robots to execute complex multi-step tasks, self-correct if a step fails, and generalize to novel situations and goals.

sentences.en: Most real-world tasks require multiple steps over an extended period of time.
sentences.zh: 大多数现实世界的任务需要在很长一段时间内执行多个步骤。

sentences.en: To manage this complexity, our embodied reasoning (ER) model, Gemini Robotics ER 2, serves as the robot’s high-level brain, processing user instructions and communicating with humans.
sentences.zh: 为了管理这种复杂性，我们的具身推理 (ER) 模型 Gemini Robotics ER 2 充当机器人的高级大脑，处理用户指令并与人类进行通信。

sentences.en: It observes the room, reasons about the steps needed to complete the task, coordinates with the VLA to carry out the actions, and tracks progress until the task is done.
sentences.zh: 它观察房间，推理完成任务所需的步骤，与 VLA 协调执行操作，并跟踪进度直至任务完成。

sentences.en: This setup allows robots to execute complex multi-step tasks, self-correct if a step fails, and generalize to novel situations and goals.
sentences.zh: 这种设置允许机器人执行复杂的多步骤任务，在步骤失败时进行自我纠正，并推广到新的情况和目标。

blocks.html_en: In this update, we are enabling robots to more reliably execute longer task sequences, lasting several minutes and involving hundreds of decisions. Gemini Robotics ER 2 now understands when tasks begin and end, and can pinpoint the moment key events occur, marking a step change in progress understanding.

sentences.en: In this update, we are enabling robots to more reliably execute longer task sequences, lasting several minutes and involving hundreds of decisions.
sentences.zh: 在此更新中，我们使机器人能够更可靠地执行更长的任务序列，持续几分钟并涉及数百个决策。

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics ER 2 now understands when tasks begin and end, and can pinpoint the moment key events occur, marking a step change in progress understanding.
sentences.zh: Gemini Robotics ER 2 现在可以了解任务何时开始和结束，并可以精确定位关键事件发生的时刻，这标志着进度理解的重大变化。

blocks.html_en: Furthermore, we are introducing multi-robot collaboration. This enables different types of robots to communicate and work together to solve complex workflows a single robot could not do alone.

sentences.en: Furthermore, we are introducing multi-robot collaboration.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们正在引入多机器人协作。

sentences.en: This enables different types of robots to communicate and work together to solve complex workflows a single robot could not do alone.
sentences.zh: 这使得不同类型的机器人能够进行通信和协同工作，以解决单个机器人无法单独完成的复杂工作流程。

blocks.html_en: Adapting fast on-device models for any robot

sentences.en: Adapting fast on-device models for any robot
sentences.zh: 为任何机器人快速调整设备上的模型

blocks.html_en: Many robotic applications need to operate without network latency or internet connectivity. Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 is built specifically to handle these constraints — it is our most-efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices.

sentences.en: Many robotic applications need to operate without network latency or internet connectivity.
sentences.zh: 许多机器人应用程序需要在没有网络延迟或互联网连接的情况下运行。

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 is built specifically to handle these constraints — it is our most-efficient vision-language-action model (VLA) optimized to run locally on robotic devices.
sentences.zh: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 专为处理这些限制而构建 - 它是我们最高效的视觉语言动作模型 (VLA)，经过优化可在机器人设备上本地运行。

blocks.html_en: This model is natively multi-embodiment and inherits our advanced “motion transfer” techniques from Gemini Robotics 1.5. We can now adapt to new bi-arm robot embodiments with just a few hours of adaptation time, typically with less than 200 examples. This works even with new embodiments with drastically different shapes, sensors and degrees of freedom, as shown below with a diverse set of tasks being performed by the Dexmate, SO101, and Trossen platforms.

sentences.en: This model is natively multi-embodiment and inherits our advanced “motion transfer” techniques from Gemini Robotics 1.5.
sentences.zh: 该模型本身就是多实施例，并继承了我们来自 Gemini Robotics 1.5 的先进“运动转移”技术。

sentences.en: We can now adapt to new bi-arm robot embodiments with just a few hours of adaptation time, typically with less than 200 examples.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们只需几个小时的适应时间（通常少于 200 个示例）即可适应新的双臂机器人实施例。

sentences.en: This works even with new embodiments with drastically different shapes, sensors and degrees of freedom, as shown below with a diverse set of tasks being performed by the Dexmate, SO101, and Trossen platforms.
sentences.zh: 即使对于具有截然不同的形状、传感器和自由度的新实施例，这也适用，如下所示，Dexmate、SO101 和 Trossen 平台执行不同的任务集。

blocks.html_en: Advancing our commitment to safe and responsible robotics

sentences.en: Advancing our commitment to safe and responsible robotics
sentences.zh: 推进我们对安全和负责任的机器人技术的承诺

blocks.html_en: Safety is foundational to our robotics research. As robots gain more physical capabilities, we are committed to ensuring end-to-end safety and alignment. With each release, we’ve taken a multi-layered approach that combines traditional physical safety measures with robust AI safety frameworks.

sentences.en: Safety is foundational to our robotics research.
sentences.zh: 安全是我们机器人研究的基础。

sentences.en: As robots gain more physical capabilities, we are committed to ensuring end-to-end safety and alignment.
sentences.zh: 随着机器人获得更多的物理能力，我们致力于确保端到端的安全性和一致性。

sentences.en: With each release, we’ve taken a multi-layered approach that combines traditional physical safety measures with robust AI safety frameworks.
sentences.zh: 在每个版本中，我们都采取了多层方法，将传统的物理安全措施与强大的人工智能安全框架相结合。

blocks.html_en: Gemini Robotics 2 specifically advances robotics safety for navigating the uncertainty of the real world and collaborating alongside humans.

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics 2 specifically advances robotics safety for navigating the uncertainty of the real world and collaborating alongside humans.
sentences.zh: Gemini Robotics 2 特别提高了机器人技术的安全性，以应对现实世界的不确定性并与人类合作。

blocks.html_en: We’re introducing ASIMOV-Agentic, a new benchmark for agentic safety orchestration and uncertainty resolution. For example, it measures the embodied reasoning agent’s ability to refuse unsafe tool calls from a VLA.It also measures the agent’s ability to predict whether a task is possible and to proactively request human intervention when uncertain.

sentences.en: We’re introducing ASIMOV-Agentic, a new benchmark for agentic safety orchestration and uncertainty resolution.
sentences.zh: 我们正在推出 ASIMOV-Agentic，这是代理安全编排和不确定性解决的新基准。

sentences.en: For example, it measures the embodied reasoning agent’s ability to refuse unsafe tool calls from a VLA.It also measures the agent’s ability to predict whether a task is possible and to proactively request human intervention when uncertain.
sentences.zh: 例如，它衡量实体推理代理拒绝来自 VLA 的不安全工具调用的能力。 它还衡量代理预测任务是否可行以及在不确定时主动请求人工干预的能力。

blocks.html_en: Additionally, with enhanced embodied reasoning, Gemini Robotics ER 2 is our safest robotics model to date in safety constraint following and human proximity benchmarks. It can better detect when humans are nearby, trigger safety tool calls and bring the robot to a safe stop if someone approaches too closely. This is a key requirement in collaborative safety standards. Read our Gemini Robotics 2: Safety Technical Report for more details.

sentences.en: Additionally, with enhanced embodied reasoning, Gemini Robotics ER 2 is our safest robotics model to date in safety constraint following and human proximity benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 此外，凭借增强的具体推理，Gemini Robotics ER 2 是我们迄今为止在安全约束遵循和人类接近基准方面最安全的机器人模型。

sentences.en: It can better detect when humans are nearby, trigger safety tool calls and bring the robot to a safe stop if someone approaches too closely.
sentences.zh: 它可以更好地检测人类何时在附近，触发安全工具调用，并在有人靠近时让机器人安全停止。

sentences.en: This is a key requirement in collaborative safety standards.
sentences.zh: 这是协作安全标准的关键要求。

sentences.en: Read our Gemini Robotics 2: Safety Technical Report for more details.
sentences.zh: 请阅读我们的 Gemini Robotics 2：安全技术报告了解更多详细信息。

blocks.html_en: Building towards general-purpose physical AI

sentences.en: Building towards general-purpose physical AI
sentences.zh: 构建通用物理人工智能

blocks.html_en: Gemini Robotics 2 marks an important milestone on the path toward solving AGI in the physical world. Unlocking the true potential of robotics requires moving past single-task automation toward general-purpose intelligence. By building this core intelligence, our goal is to enable AI in the physical world that can work alongside humans to solve complex challenges.

sentences.en: Gemini Robotics 2 marks an important milestone on the path toward solving AGI in the physical world.
sentences.zh: Gemini Robotics 2 标志着在物理世界中解决 AGI 问题的道路上的一个重要里程碑。

sentences.en: Unlocking the true potential of robotics requires moving past single-task automation toward general-purpose intelligence.
sentences.zh: 释放机器人技术的真正潜力需要从单一任务自动化转向通用智能。

sentences.en: By building this core intelligence, our goal is to enable AI in the physical world that can work alongside humans to solve complex challenges.
sentences.zh: 通过构建这种核心智能，我们的目标是让人工智能在现实世界中能够与人类一起解决复杂的挑战。

2026 年 7 月 30 日 型号

卡罗莱纳·帕拉达

从脚到指尖——我们正在教授机器人智能全身控制、精细的灵活性和团队合作，以完成各种复杂的任务

几十年来，我们一直梦想着机器人能够无缝地走进我们的世界并伸出援手。 现在，这一愿景向前迈出了一大步。

大多数机器人都经过预先编程或远程操作，以执行狭窄的重复性任务序列。 他们缺乏真正自学或适应不可预测环境的能力。 此外，将学到的技能从一个机器人身体转移到另一个机器人身体仍然非常困难。 为了大规模解决最困难的问题，各种形状和大小的机器人都需要人工智能模型，使它们能够智能地思考、行动和交互，以安全地完成任务。

我们展示了 Gemini 的多模式理解如何通过 Gemini Robotics 推动现实世界的行动。 今天，我们推出 Gemini Robotics 2 - 为下一代真正适应性强的机器人提供动力的智能层。 当它迈出真正的第一步时，这一重大进步解锁了智能全身控制、高级灵活性和多机器人协作。

Gemini Robotics 2 使机器人能够对每一个动作进行推理，从而解锁广泛的任务。 例如，它可以使人形机器人能够行走、蹲伏、伸展和操纵物体来清理杂乱的房间。 它甚至可以与其他机器人合作，更快地完成工作。 这种深刻的智能还可以在设备上本地运行，同时在短短几个小时内无缝适应全新的机器人身体。

我们通过三个高性能模型使这成为可能：

  • Gemini Robotics 2：我们最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），可将视觉和语言输入转换为运动控制，使机器人能够采取行动。 该模型能够控制从脚到指尖的完整人形机器人以及其他双臂机器人。 它还将双手和抓手的灵巧操控提升到了新的水平。
  • Gemini Robotics ER 2：我们最强大的具身推理 (ER) 模型。 它是一种视觉语言模型（VLM），充当我们的代理，使机器人能够与人类交流，理解物理世界并规划持续几分钟的多步骤任务。 我们还介绍了机器人作为一个团队一起工作的能力。
  • Gemini Robotics On-Device 2：我们最高效的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）经过优化，可以在机器人设备上本地运行。 该模型现在可以通过几个小时的数据快速适应全新的机器人实施例。

我们的推理模型 Gemini Robotics ER 2 现已在 Google AI Studio 上提供，并在 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上提供私人预览版。 我们的 VLA 和设备端模型可供抢先体验的合作伙伴使用。 在我们的开发者博客上了解如何将这些模型引入您的硬件。

运动中的人形机器人：管理全身任务

世界是为人类运动而建立的；它要求我们在狭窄、杂乱的空间中伸展、弯曲和保持平衡。 我们之前的模型控制人形机器人的上半身来完成桌面任务，而 Gemini Robotics 2 将物理 AI 扩展到全身运动。

我们的模型现在第一次可以控制整个人形机器人，将意图转化为智能全身控制。 例如，在控制Apptronik的Apollo 2人形机器人时，我们可以要求它“将喷壶放入最底层架子的绿色垃圾桶中”。 阿波罗处理完指令，走到桌子旁，拿起喷壶，走到架子上，然后将其精确地放置在目的地。 虽然我们的机器人在移动速度方面还有更多进步，但这是朝着完成需要全身协调的更复杂、现实世界任务所需的技能迈出的重要一步。

为手和夹具带来先进的灵活性

为了在我们的家庭和工作场所真正发挥作用，机器人需要技巧。 Gemini Robotics 2 将不同末端执行器的物理灵活性提升到了一个新的水平，无论机器人是使用手还是夹具，使机器人比以往任何时候都更有用。

该模型现在可以控制 Apollo 2 机器人上的五指、22 自由度 SharpaWave 手来完成打结或密封自封袋等精细动作。 它还可以在 Franka Duo 平台上操作标准的两指平行夹具，以执行复杂的灵巧任务（例如紧密包装）。 我们正在不断提高精度和速度水平，以实现人类水平的灵活性。

通过代理推理和多机器人协作解锁高级任务

大多数现实世界的任务需要在很长一段时间内执行多个步骤。 为了管理这种复杂性，我们的具身推理 (ER) 模型 Gemini Robotics ER 2 充当机器人的高级大脑，处理用户指令并与人类进行通信。 它观察房间，推理完成任务所需的步骤，与 VLA 协调执行操作，并跟踪进度直至任务完成。 这种设置允许机器人执行复杂的多步骤任务，在步骤失败时进行自我纠正，并推广到新的情况和目标。

在此更新中，我们使机器人能够更可靠地执行更长的任务序列，持续几分钟并涉及数百个决策。 Gemini Robotics ER 2 现在可以了解任务何时开始和结束，并可以精确定位关键事件发生的时刻，这标志着进度理解的重大变化。

此外，我们正在引入多机器人协作。 这使得不同类型的机器人能够进行通信和协同工作，以解决单个机器人无法单独完成的复杂工作流程。

为任何机器人快速调整设备上的模型

许多机器人应用程序需要在没有网络延迟或互联网连接的情况下运行。 Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 专为处理这些限制而构建 - 它是我们最高效的视觉语言动作模型 (VLA)，经过优化可在机器人设备上本地运行。

该模型本身就是多实施例，并继承了我们来自 Gemini Robotics 1.5 的先进“运动转移”技术。 现在，我们只需几个小时的适应时间（通常少于 200 个示例）即可适应新的双臂机器人实施例。 即使对于具有截然不同的形状、传感器和自由度的新实施例，这也适用，如下所示，Dexmate、SO101 和 Trossen 平台执行不同的任务集。

推进我们对安全和负责任的机器人技术的承诺

安全是我们机器人研究的基础。 随着机器人获得更多的物理能力，我们致力于确保端到端的安全性和一致性。 在每个版本中，我们都采取了多层方法，将传统的物理安全措施与强大的人工智能安全框架相结合。

Gemini Robotics 2 特别提高了机器人技术的安全性，以应对现实世界的不确定性并与人类合作。

我们正在推出 ASIMOV-Agentic，这是代理安全编排和不确定性解决的新基准。 例如，它衡量实体推理代理拒绝来自 VLA 的不安全工具调用的能力。 它还衡量代理预测任务是否可行以及在不确定时主动请求人工干预的能力。

此外，凭借增强的具体推理，Gemini Robotics ER 2 是我们迄今为止在安全约束遵循和人类接近基准方面最安全的机器人模型。 它可以更好地检测人类何时在附近，触发安全工具调用，并在有人靠近时让机器人安全停止。 这是协作安全标准的关键要求。 请阅读我们的 Gemini Robotics 2：安全技术报告了解更多详细信息。

构建通用物理人工智能

Gemini Robotics 2 标志着在物理世界中解决 AGI 问题的道路上的一个重要里程碑。 释放机器人技术的真正潜力需要从单一任务自动化转向通用智能。 通过构建这种核心智能，我们的目标是让人工智能在现实世界中能够与人类一起解决复杂的挑战。
